scenarios.task: Reset displaced stone slabs on Dashashwamedh Ghat steps where river scour and crowd wear have loosened paving.
steps: Barricade the work bay and post crowd marshals before aarti peak
Pry the loose slab with a long bar, keeping feet clear of drop zone
Cart debris to the spoil point; never throw stone down steps
Bed fresh mortar and set the slab level with the tread line
Strike joints and clean the surface before opening to foot traffic
Log the repaired step number for the Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: Barricade and marshals in place before any slab is lifted
Slab moved with bar and cart, no lifting above waist solo
Set slab flush within 3 mm of adjacent treads
No debris or mortar left on open steps at handover

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a LIDAR scan of step displacement and ferries small tools between bays so apprentices keep both hands free on stone.

scenarios.task: Install weatherproof festival lighting circuits on scaffold towers above the ghat steps for evening ceremonies, with GFCI protection near water.
hazards: Overhead clearance for boats and flags
Lead and old wiring in heritage fabric
Working at height on tube-and-clamp scaffold
ppe: Life jacket near open water edge
steps: Verify scaffold tag and inspect planks before climbing
Kill and lock out the feeder at the temporary panel
Run Sealed connectors and drip loops on all ghat-face runs
Test GFCI trip at every receptacle before energizing
Torqued terminations checked, panel labeled, then energize under permit
Record as-built circuit list for the Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: Feeder locked out and tagged before any conductor work
All exterior joints use drip loops and rated enclosures
Every receptacle trip-tested and logged
100 percent tie-off above 1.8 m

scenarios.task: Clear and reline a storm drain outfall under the ghat retaining wall that discharges to the Ganges, working in a short confined vault.
hazards: Sudden river rise during release of upstream dam water
steps: Obtain confined-space permit and test atmosphere at three depths
Station an attendant and tripod retrieval at the vault mouth
Flush the vault with the vent fan running before entry
Bench the pipe invert and set the relining sleeve
Grout annulus and verify slope with a level
Decontaminate gear and close the permit

rubric.pass_if: Permit opened, atmosphere logged, attendant posted before entry
River stage checked for dam release schedule before entry
Sleeve set to line and grade with sealed annulus
Gross decon of suit and tools completed before break

scenarios.robot_role: Stages relining sleeves at the vault mouth and tows the spoil tub out along the ghat apron so no one hauls load through the confined entry.

scenarios.task: Rig and fly a steel bell frame onto a pavilion column over the ghat plaza using a mobile crane on the stepped apron.
hazards: Crane setup on stone steps and soft river fill
Tag-line snag on scaffolds and flags
Wind gusts off the river corridor
steps: Survey the apron; mat and crib every outrigger float
Verify load chart for radius and pick weight; hold a pre-lift huddle
Rig the frame with chokers at marked pick points and a tag line
Clear the plaza and confirm wind under limit
Lift, hover, and walk the load to the column heads
Land, unbuckle, and inspect the rigging before return to the rack

rubric.pass_if: All outriggers fully extended on mats bridging steps
Chokers rated and set at engineered pick points
Plaza cleared and signal person sole voice authority
Wind and radius verified against chart before the pick

scenarios.task: Coordinate boat and truck movements at the ghat landing during material delivery, keeping pilgrim boats and delivery barges separated.
hazards: Water-side crush between hull and steps
steps: Set the delivery window outside ceremony hours
Brief barge crew on the landing point and line plan
Heave mooring lines with no one between hull and steps
Offload pallets via gangway, three points of contact
Stage materials clear of the procession route
Log delivery counts for the Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: No movements overlap ceremony crowds
No hands or bodies between hull and stone at any time
Pallets banded and staged off the walkway
Single spotter directs each movement with radio backup

scenarios.task: Stabilize flaking lead-based paint on the ghat pavilion ceiling before repainting, using containment and wet methods.
steps: Build containment sheeting and a floor drop over the walkway
Wet-scrape and HEPA-vacuum flaking zones, no dry sanding
Bag waste as regulated lead debris and label drums
Wipe surfaces clean and verify with clearance sampling
Break containment top-down and decontaminate workers
Document waste manifest for the Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: Sheeting and drop fully isolate the work before scraping
Wet methods and HEPA only; zero dry abrasion
All debris bagged, labeled, and manifested
Coveralls removed and hands washed before break area

scenarios.task: Walk the ghat steps before dawn aarti to map loose stones, water pooling, and trip hazards for the maintenance backlog.
hazards: Crowd buildup near the ceremony platforms
steps: Brief with the ghat committee on ceremony timing
Walk the step bays in pairs from north to south
Photograph and number each defect location
Flag immediate hazards with chalk and cones
File the defect list to the Progress Tracker before crowd arrival

rubric.pass_if: Every step bay walked and logged
Trip hazards marked before public access
Defect list numbered with photos
Scan complete before ceremony crowd buildup

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the thermal and LIDAR payload on the narrow step runs, flagging pooling water and loose slabs so apprentices only hand-verify flagged bays.
